supplies.analysis: The budget of €180,000 exceeds the EU threshold of €221,000 for a single lot, so we must divide the requirement into multiple lots. We cannot procure services, so laptops are within our mandate. We will follow the standard procedure, but since we need to split the large requirement, we'll allocate a sustainability criterion, a competitive procedure, and a value below the EU threshold for each lot.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Due to the large requirement, we must split the procurement of 200 laptops into four lots to stay within EU thresholds. We'll follow a standard competitive procedure with negotiation for each lot, with a sustainability criterion of energy label A or better. The budget will be divided as follows: 34% for supplies, with 9% allocated to each of the four lots (Laptops 1-4) for a total of €180,000. Note that the maximum budget share for any single contract type is 60%, which was not respected in this case. Our confidence in this recommendation is medium, as the sub-agents' analysis identified potential issues with the large requirement. We've also escalated these concerns to the principal for review.
